title: Named Hibernate bean requests preserve injection and fallback identity
summary: The named Hibernate prototype now receives its originating Spring context. Named fallback creation retains X, and an absent name no longer resolves to a differently named Spring prototype.

change.description: SpringBeanContainer autowires properties of named JPA-managed instances and preserves the requested name when Spring must delegate creation to Hibernate’s fallback producer.

notes: The caller boots the original native Hibernate XML on HSQLDB and obtains BeanContainer from the unwrapped SessionFactory. The producer records both overloads.
Each pin supplies its changed production classes on spring-orm 5.1.4.RELEASE. The replay verifies the loaded class origins and all class digests of each compiled slice.
